name: cftrace
description: Displays and logs debugging data about the state of an application at the time the cftrace tag executes.

params.name: abort
params.description: Calls cfabort tag when the tag is executed

params.name: category
params.description: User-defined string for identifying trace groups

params.name: inline
params.description:
Displays trace code in line on the page in the
location of the cftrace tag, addition to the debugging
information output.

params.name: text
params.description:
User-defined string, which can include simple variable,
but not complex variables such as arrays. Outputs to cflog
text attribute

params.name: type
params.description:
Corresponds to the cflog type attribute; displays an
appropriate icon.

- Information
- Warning
- Error
- Fatal

params.name: var
params.description:
The name of a simple or complex variable to display.

Useful for displaying a temporary value, or a value that
does not display on any CFM page.

params.name: follow
params.description: If true, Lucee follows the object defined in the [var] attribute and will log any changes to it. Ignored when attribute [var] is not defined.
